beats.say: FFmpeg 9.1, codenamed Gauss, is the latest release of the open-source multimedia framework, which ships a new major version about every six months.
FFmpeg only provides source code, so ready-to-run builds come from other providers linked on the download page.
Releases are cryptographically signed, and the newest also carry post-quantum signatures that GnuPG cannot verify yet — you need sq 1.4 or later.

hook: FFmpeg's new release signs with post-quantum keys.
